evaluation.justice: Pedestrian priority closed management, vehicle access restricted by bollards, maximum protection of pedestrian rights.
evaluation.safety: Water-facing guardrails, physical vehicle isolation, almost zero safety risk for pedestrians.
evaluation.livability: Waterfront ecological scenery, open view, excellent leisure and recreation attribute.
evaluation.sustainability: Surrounding wetland and natural vegetation, superior ecological environment.
evaluation.aesthetics: Waterfront bridge architectural design, wide lake view, high landscape ornamental value.
evaluation.comfort: Open field of vision, natural wind environment, quiet and comfortable.
evaluation.walkability: Pedestrian-only dedicated slow travel space, perfect leisure walking experience.
evaluation.bikeability: Allowed for slow leisure cycling, restricted from high-speed riding.
